Every quorvel element, a newly proposed.why:
The quorvel elements are made up: no kind of HTML element by that name exists, and no text states this. The class above them (HTML elements) is real and leaves the end-tag rule open (
requires an end tag,
forbids one), and the new conclusion (an end tag is required) is the one the revised rule gives, so the record tests acquiring a new rule for an unknown element kind, one that could exist unrecorded among proposals for new HTML elements.

The <vorn> element takes an end tag..why: Made up, so stated nowhere: nobody writes a fact about something that does not exist. It follows only from the inserted rule and the membership given in the prompt, which is how people state things about a member of a group: through its group.
